title: Make twins
goalLine: Link the two parcels with a thread.

hints.text: Apply the lens-changer to parcel A first, then use the linker.
Order matters: change the lens on one parcel first, then link them.

events.no-visible-change: Using the linker first on unlinked parcels leaves them unchanged.

removePhysicsNote: Without the linker the parcels stay independent, so no thread ever appears.
